title: Mixing: Wings Over Europe Tour | 1973
content:
Control Room Four, EMI Studios, London
Producer: Paul McCartney
Engineer: Alan Parsons

The last of three consecutive days spent mixing Wings live recordings took place on 18 April 1973.

The recordings were made from 19-24 August 1972 during the Wings Over Europe Tour. Paul McCartney had planned to release some of them on Red Rose Speedway, but had decided instead to release the footage as a film, titled The Bruce McMouse Show. The live performances would be interspersed with animated footage of a family of mice living underneath the stage.

On this day stereo mixes were made of ‘I Am Your Singer’ and ‘My Love’ from The Hague on 21 August; and ‘Maybe I’m Amazed’, ‘Hi, Hi, Hi’, and ‘Long Tall Sally’ from Groningen on 19 August.
